reason: A DSH Web UI plugin suite primarily focused on interface enhancements, including skins, panels, visualizations, mobile access, task automation, SSH operations, and image understanding.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、任务看板、Git 图谱、侧边面板、移动端远程和 SSH 等界面与工作流扩展。
summaries.en: A pluggable DeepSeek Harness Web UI suite providing themes, task boards, Git visualizations, side panels, mobile access, SSH operations, and related workflow extensions.

capabilities: modifies the DSH Web UI with panels, task boards, Git visualizations, skins, and mobile interfaces
can schedule and execute tasks through DSH agent sessions
can connect to remote hosts over SSH, execute commands, transfer files, and create tunnels
can send images to configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints for analysis
